en.p: In the coordinate plane, for a right triangle $\mathrm{ABC}$ with $\overline{\mathrm{AB}}=\overline{\mathrm{AC}}$ and $\angle\mathrm{BAC}=\dfrac{\pi}{2}$, two points $\mathrm{P}$, $\mathrm{Q}$ satisfy the following conditions.
For a point $\mathrm{X}$ on segment $\mathrm{AQ}$, let $m$ be the minimum value of $\left|\overrightarrow{\mathrm{XA}}+\overrightarrow{\mathrm{XB}}\right|$. Find the value of $m^{2}$. [4 points]
